proposal.summary: An authenticated path traversal in the ArubaOS web-based management interface can be exploited to delete arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

AV.quote: An authenticated path traversal vulnerability exists in the ArubaOS web-based management interface.

PR.quote: An authenticated path traversal vulnerability exists in the ArubaOS web-based management interface.

C.quote: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability results in the ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.

I.quote: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability results in the ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.

A.quote: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability results in the ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a full technical report from the reporter including: affected ArubaOS versions, exact vulnerable endpoint and request parameters, authentication requirements, proof-of-concept details showing the path traversal and file deletion, and any available mitigations or patches.
